d:
"Heya! Here's the chapter art I did for a Roommates short series called "Rise of the Double Draco", by @MrTrikey!
It's a dream come true to make art for a series that brought me into the furry fandom - give this chapter (https://*****/rotdd1) and the rest of Roommates a read!" - Artist

This is a short series that is a direct sequel to Two for One! - https://e-hentai.org/g/1259494/94258da53e
Featuring further development of Sean and the Lee twins's relationship, and other intrigue behind their pasts.
